title: Module 11 quiz — AWS Container Platforms
description: Eight questions on ECR, ECS/Fargate, EKS literacy, ALB health, IAM, cost. us-west-2. Synthetic BayPay.

questions.prompt: Why is :latest a bad ECR tag for payment-service in us-west-2?
choices: ECR forbids the word latest
You cannot prove which bits a task ran, and two deploys may pull different images
Fargate cannot pull tagged images
Avery Chen’s UUID cannot be in a tag
questions.explanation: Pin a version or digest. Same rule as Module 9 registries.

questions.prompt: Why is ECS on Fargate the student-apply default instead of EKS?
choices: EKS cannot run Java
EKS control plane and often NAT/nodes cost more than a 90-minute lab needs; Fargate is enough to learn task defs and ALB
OpenShift forbids Fargate
Fargate includes RDS for free
questions.explanation: ACCOUNT.md: no EKS/NAT unless cost is the lesson. ARCHITECT-1102 is where EKS can win.

questions.prompt: ECS task RUNNING, ALB target unhealthy, GET / returns 404 from Spring. First honest class?
choices: The cluster is out of EC2
The load balancer health check does not match a 200 the app actually serves
Route 53 is down worldwide
dmgr-east must be bounced
questions.explanation: Health path/port/matcher — not ‘ECS is dead.’ Use /actuator/health/liveness.

questions.prompt: Who should read Secrets Manager for BAYPAY_DB_PASSWORD?
choices: The ALB
The task role (app) or execution role (inject at start) — never a plaintext env in git
Anonymous internet
The ECR scan role
questions.explanation: Execution role pulls secrets into the container; task role is for app AWS APIs. Split them.

questions.prompt: An idle ALB left over the weekend is a problem because:
choices: ALB is free after 1 hour
ALB hourly + LCU charges continue with zero traffic; destroy-after-lab exists for this
Fargate pays the ALB bill
CloudWatch cannot see ALBs
questions.explanation: COST-1105: idle ALB is the classic leftover.

questions.prompt: When might EKS or OpenShift beat ECS for BayPay?
choices: Never; this course forbids them
When you already run Kubernetes/OpenShift skills, need portable YAML, or platform features ECS does not provide — and you accept the cost
When you want NAT Gateways for fun
When you must run WebSphere ND
questions.explanation: ARCHITECT-1102 is a trade-off, not a slogan.

questions.prompt: Student apply in this course should create RDS Multi-AZ because payments need a database. True?
choices: True; always create prod RDS in a 90-minute lab
False; RDS is literacy in L-11.7; local H2/Postgres or a disclosed estimate — do not spawn Multi-AZ for the lab
True if the region is us-east-1
False because Spring cannot use RDS
questions.explanation: Cost and cleanup. Do not ‘make it real’ with Multi-AZ.

questions.prompt: Can you pass BUILD-1101 without terraform apply?
choices: No; AWS is pass/fail only if the ALB is green
Yes; paper + terraform validate + a destroy plan is the designed path if you cannot spend
Only if you use EKS
Only on OpenShift
questions.explanation: Apply is optional. Validate is the bar.
